hero.description: Hairdressers, doctors, vehicle inspections, banks… Digitize your queue in 2 minutes. The customer scans a QR code, follows their turn on their mobile, and you manage everything from a dashboard.
hero.noCard: No credit card required. Setup in 2 minutes.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps to transform the waiting experience.
howItWorks.step1Desc: A QR code at the entrance — no app to install. They get their ticket in 5 seconds.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Position, estimated time, notification when their turn is near. They can leave.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Real-time dashboard + analytics: peak hours, average duration, loyalty.
howItWorks.beforeDesc: Customers standing, stressed, time wasted. Endless queues with no visibility.
howItWorks.afterDesc: Scan QR, real-time tracking on mobile. Free customers, efficient staff.

features.title: Everything you need
features.feature1Desc: The customer is notified when their turn is approaching.
features.feature2Desc: Assign customers to a hairdresser, advisor, doctor…
features.feature3Desc: Peak hours, average duration, no-show rate.
features.feature4Desc: No installation required. Works on any mobile device.
